rationale: Despite an 8.37% gap down on 5.45x relative volume, DLO has absorbed morning selling pressure and pushed into the upper third of its intraday range, holding above both session VWAP ($13.94) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.97). The current four-bar pullback on the 1-minute chart brings price right into the $13.94-$14.00 support zone, providing a tight entry to test the $14.20 high of day and begin filling the overhead gap with invalidation set below VWAP at $13.85.
